div.div: p0/p2 = follower ports on the same NIC (one SLAVE, one LISTENING — if the SLAVE port loses the GM, the LISTENING port transitions to SLAVE). p1/p3 = the grandmaster's 2 ports (same node, same NIC). Each GM port connects directly to one of the follower ports.
